At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients through innovative antibody-based medicines. To support our biologics pipeline and portfolio, we are looking for a CMC Senior Stability Specialist in the CMC Stability department to strengthen our CMC organization with a focus on life-cycle-management activities.

**The Role and Department

**As CMC Senior Stability Specialist, you will be part of the CMC Stability department organized in CMC Development and Manufacturing. The CMC Stability department supports the Genmab portfolio from early CMC development projects to commercial products. Additionally, you will be part of and collaborate with CMC project teams

You will join a department of eight skilled and dedicated employees. In the role, you will be responsible for stability, governance of products and collaborate closely with colleagues within the department, across CMC, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Supply, and with external partners at CDMO’s/CMO’s in a highly matrixed, international environment.

Besides having extended experience with biologics and stability, the ideal candidate is statistically well-founded and can help advance the department’s data-handling capabilities.

This position will report to the Head of Department, CMC Stability.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as stability subject matter expert supporting Genmab’s biologics products.

• Ensure alignment and oversight of stability activities performed at external partners, CDMO’s/CMO’s, and internal laboratories.

• Ensure scientifically sound and regulatory-compliant stability approaches aligned with ICH guidelines and regulations.

• Perform and oversee statistical evaluation of stability data, including data handling, trend analysis and shelf-life determination.

• Author and review CMC sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, BLA/MAA, variations).

• Support health authority interactions, e.g. be part of the request for information processes for topics related to stability.

• Be part of establishing a mature life-cycle-management set-up for commercial products.

**Requirements

**

• PhD or MSc in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, biochemistry, statistics, or related discipline.

• Significant experience (typically 7+ years) within CMC stability for biologics and strong knowledge of ICH guidelines, including Q1A–Q1E, Q5C, and Q6B.

• Extensive knowledge and understanding of stability for marketed biologics/clinical biological products according to current requirements and best industrial practices.

• Demonstrated knowledge and experience in statistical methods applied to stability data (e.g. regression analysis, pooling, trend analysis).

• Experience working and interacting with CDMO’s/CMO’s.

• Experience with supporting global regulatory submissions.

• Ability to translate complex scientific and statistical data into clear regulatory and business recommendations.

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• You seek and have demonstrated ability to collaborate with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to support product development programs.

• You have a structured and analytical approach when solving problems.

• Flair for IT and user software to monitor stability.

• You can manage multiple tasks, prioritize work, and define steps needed to achieve project and department goals.

• You can work successfully and with integrity in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.

**What You Can Expect At Genmab

**

• A high-impact role in a science-driven organization focused on patients.

• A collaborative and inclusive culture with strong cross-functional teamwork.

• Opportunities to shape strategy and contribute to key project decisions.

• Professional growth in a global biologics company with a strong pipeline.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: Lead Developer to support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced developer interested in building high-quality software and contributing to critical applications that support the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of the Nordic power grid? If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.  

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment, where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.  

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with two Lead Developers and five Senior Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC. 

Your role 

As a Lead Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative department of approximately 23 developers who design, develop and maintain the internal applications supporting our current and future business services. If you are curious about Nordic RCC and what we do, learn more about our innovative solutions on the Nordic RCC webpage. 

Your role combines hands-on development with broader technical leadership. You will work closely with Application Architects to help define and communicate technical direction, translate architectural principles into practical solutions and promote consistency across our application landscape. 

You will connect technical expertise across teams, identify shared challenges, and contribute to reusable, sustainable solutions. Through cross-departmental collaboration, you will build alignment around technical opportunities, constraints, and impacts across the organization. 

What you will do :  

• 
Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET, while promoting consistent standards, code quality, maintainability and operational stability

• 
Contribute to improving system architecture by identifying areas for technical refinement, refactoring, or modernization  

• 
Collaborating across the organization, represent Application Development by collaborating with Product Owners, Delivery Management, testers, Quality Management and other departments

• 
Set and communicate technical direction with Application Architects, translating architectural principles and business needs into practical solutions and Architecture Decision Records

• 
Connect technical expertise across teams and applications, enabling collaboration on dependencies, common challenges and reusable solutions

• 
Support operational excellence by helping diagnose and resolve production issues and continuously optimize existing systems  

• 
Share knowledge and technical expertise supporting colleagues’ professional development and help strengthen development practices across the team. This role does not include formal line-management responsibilities

Technology Stack:  

• 
Primary languages and frameworks  
C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python  

• 
Architecture, design patterns & integrations  
Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs 

• 
Databases & storage 
Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3 

• 
Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  
Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX  

• 
Tooling and collaboration  
Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines  

We’re looking for someone with:  

• 
Collaborative Attitude: You will be working closely with our team of Application Architects, shaping architectural decisions for supporting maintainable, scalable and robust systems

• 
Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

• 
Proven Expertise: Minimum 5 years’ experience as full-stack developer in C# for the .NET platform. Experience providing technical guidance, facilitating technical decisions, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating development activities is a definite plus. 

• 
Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes

• 
Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.   

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace  

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.  

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   

Application deadline and contact information  

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling  basis up until the right candidate has been found.  

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.  

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Pernille Yde Juul Hansen, Manager, Application Development pyh@nordic-rcc.net / +45 3092 3111.

Job Description

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

What you'll do

This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

What we offer

You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About The Tech Collective

We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

The Role

Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• 
Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• 
Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• 
Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• 
Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• 
Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• 
Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• 
Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• 
Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• 
Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• 
Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• 
Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• 
Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• 
Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• 
Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

Experience & Skills

• 
4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• 
A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• 
Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• 
Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• 
Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• 
Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• 
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

• 
Customer-focused; you start with what the customer needs, not what the business wants to tell them

• 
A builder by nature; you are energised by the blank page, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating something that didn't exist before

• 
Commercially grounded; you understand how customer marketing connects to revenue and are comfortable being held to NRR and expansion metrics

• 
A natural collaborator; you build trust across functions without needing a mandate, and you bring people with you rather than working around them

• 
Clear and direct communicator; both written and verbal; you can simplify the complex, adapt your message to your audience, and get the room aligned

• 
AI-curious; you actively explore how AI can improve how you work, from personalisation and segmentation to content creation and performance analysis

Why Planday

• 
A genuinely greenfield opportunity, you will define what customer marketing looks like at Planday and build it your way

• 
Work at the intersection of commercial growth and customer experience, your work will have direct, measurable impact on retention and expansion

• 
A collaborative, ambitious marketing team that values craft, clarity, and getting things done

• 
Flexible location - London or Copenhagen, with a hybrid working model

• 
Competitive salary, benefits, and the opportunity to grow with the business as the function scales
